notes: RAGAnswerRuntime owns the ask-family runtime request and execution wrapper.
EvidenceAssemblyService assembles retrieval-backed evidence, citations, answerability, and context budget into EvidencePacket.
It does not currently read papers_dir structured_evidence SourceSpan or StrictEvidence JSONL stores.
Answer payloads build evidencePacketContract from the assembled EvidencePacket.
Strict mode keeps only spans with sourceContentHash, spanOffsetAvailable, source id, and non-stale status.
AnswerContract citations are emitted only for evidence spans with strict provenance.
If no strict citations survive, the answer contract abstains with missing_strict_citations or an answerability reason.
StrictEvidence rows have the right paperId, sourceContentHash, authority, and verbatim hash invariants.
Their store contract still explicitly sets runtimeUseAllowed, citationUseAllowed, and answerIntegrationAllowed to false.
Runtime binding records are append-only candidates but still keep runtimeVisible and answerIntegrationVisible false.
The current executor explicitly says parent evidence stores are read-only and answer surfaces stay disabled.
